verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the JMAP API, API tokens and OAuth/Bearer auth. These are developer building blocks for constructing agent access, not an official MCP server, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
